items.md: Can you link the reference information with the citation information (Sources)? So when the user hover the information, the meta information of the source can be shown?　Also please add a "Copy" button beside the meta inforamtion so I can easily copy the information and seaerch the paper by myself.

**Done.** Every citation in the post is now linked to its entry in Sources. On a phone, tap a citation; on a computer, hover. A small card shows the full reference with a **Copy** button and an **In Sources** link. The links are made automatically when the page is built, and I checked them by hand: 1 of ~100 was ambiguous and has been fixed.
